title: CsVserverCsPolicyBinding
description: Binding between a content switching virtual server and a content switching policy. Defines how requests are evaluated and routed to target load balancing virtual servers.

name.description: Name of the content switching virtual server.

policyname.description: Name of the content switching policy to bind.

targetlbvserver.description: Name of the target load balancing virtual server to which matching traffic is directed.

priority.description: Priority of the policy binding. Lower values indicate higher priority.

gotopriorityexpression.description: Expression specifying the priority of the next policy to evaluate if the current policy matches.

bindpoint.description: The bind point at which the policy is bound.
